messages:
Asha (oncall): ok team — now that kvcache-evict is mitigated, starting a follow-up thread to capture action items, owners, sizing, and Q2 tie-ins. I opened the postmortem stub: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4721>. please drop proposed actions here so we can triage by severity and sprint.

Marcus: quick customer-impact recap to help prioritization: embed-write/serve latency spiked from 80ms -> 450ms for ~7m requests over the 40m window. ~2% of requests saw 5xx. Affected customers: Streamlytics (high traffic trial), two mid-market customers. Estimated customer-visible errors ~1,200; engineering estimate of revenue exposure: low single-digit % for this window.

Priya (Product): thanks Marcus. From a product POV, Streamlytics is a high-touch account; they raised a ticket and CSE looped in CS. Would like remediation prioritized above generic backlog tasks. Recommend we treat this as P1 customer-impact for Q2 planning, but we can scope into phased work.

Ken: proposed action items (first pass):
1) "Adaptive eviction policy" — stop aggressive full-kv eviction on mem pressure; tune threshold + add leaky bucket smoothing. Owner: Ken. Est: 5d (large). Jira: INF-4722.
2) "Alert + early-warning metric" — add percent-kv-miss-rate and a rolling-5min anomaly alert, plus runbook update. Owner: Marcus. Est: 1d (small). Jira: INF-4723.
3) "Model fallback during kv storm" — route to quantized/smaller variant on cache miss flood to preserve p99 latency. Owner: Asha. Est: 3d (medium). Jira: INF-4724.
4) "Chaos test for cache eviction" — inject mem pressure in staging, validate fallback + SLA. Owner: Carla. Est: 3d (medium). Jira: INF-4725.

Carla: add one more: 5) "Improve tracing tags for cache events" so customer impact can be correlated without sampling. Owner: Carla. Est: 2d (small). Jira: INF-4726.

incident-bot: postmortem INF-4721 created by Asha. Postmortem stub: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4721 — next step: schedule 60m postmortem review with oncall + infra + product.

Marcus: thumbs on the alert item, that's the lowest lift with biggest ROI. I can knock out INF-4723 in next 48h and add runbook steps for paging thresholds.

Priya (Product): agree — alert + runbook first. For roadmap: propose phased plan into Q2 commitments: phase 1 (alerts + runbook + tracing) = high priority for immediate sprint, phase 2 (eviction policy + fallback) = target for Q2 major. We should mark INF-4722 and INF-4724 as Q2 candidates with medium-high priority.

Asha (oncall): can someone volunteer to schedule the postmortem? ideally next Tue or Wed, include CS and Streamlytics POC. I can host. Use `#incidents` calendar or /cal.

Ken: I can draft the technical design doc for adaptive eviction today — will link to INF-4722 and add rough milestones.

Carla: will start chaos test plan, want to coordinate with Ken on staging config.

SRE Bot: calendar invite created: Postmortem - INF-4721 — 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC (60m). Invite: https://calendar.redwood/pm-inf-4721 — attendees: Asha, Marcus, Ken, Priya, Carla, CS.

Priya (Product): please add a priority tag on each Jira: P0/P1/P2. My recommendation: INF-4723 -> P0, INF-4726 -> P1, INF-4725 -> P1, INF-4722 & INF-4724 -> P1.5 (requires roadmap sign-off).

Asha (oncall): action checklist so we can close triage: 
- Marcus: INF-4723 alert + runbook (owner) — est 1d — due EOD +2 days.
- Carla: INF-4726 tracing tags + INF-4725 chaos test plan — est 2d + 3d — due EOD +6 days.
- Ken: INF-4722 design + initial PR (owner) — est 5d — target next sprint start.
- Asha: INF-4724 fallback routing prototype — est 3d — target next sprint.
- Priya: tag roadmap thread and confirm Q2 commitment (owner) — due EOD +3 days.

Marcus: +1 on checklist. I'll post progress updates to this thread and link PRs.

Priya (Product): when we do the postmortem, please capture severity rationale (customer-impact vs system SLO breach) so PMs and roadmap owners can weigh tradeoffs. Also capture regressions / config changes that triggered it, and whether rollout/fallback policy would have prevented customer impact.

Ken: noted. I'll include a short experiment plan for a smaller rollout for eviction policy so we can canary and measure before full deploy.

Asha (oncall): thanks — I'll convert this thread into the action-item tracker in the postmortem doc after the meeting and assign owners there. If anyone disagrees on sizing/priority, speak now or we'll lock this as the baseline for sprint planning. :thumbsup:

Carla: :thumbsup: will link INF-4725 & INF-4726 PRs and tests here when ready.

Marcus: starting INF-4723 now. ping me in thread if you need test metrics or logs.

incident-bot: reminder scheduled — postmortem in 48h.

Asha (oncall): closing note — focus order for resourcing: 1) alert/runbook, 2) tracing + chaos, 3) fallback + eviction policy design. We'll mark this as high-priority for the upcoming sprint planning. Thanks all.
